messages.content: if I add up all the user CU numbers you gave me, should they equal the total capacity CU for the day?

script.text: No, and they won't reconcile for three reasons: non-semantic-model workloads (dataflows, pipelines, OneLake activity) consume real capacity CU but never appear in per-user attribution at all; refresh attribution is inconsistent -- some refreshes get an owner, others don't; and background/system work is unattributed by construction. On top of that, each user's sharePct is a percentage of monitored CU (the attributed subset), not of total capacity CU -- summing shares of a smaller denominator will never equal 100% of the bigger one. The gap itself is informative: it's roughly how much activity this data source is blind to.
